step: cook curd with egg, butter, caraway
text: Whole milk is heated and curd added; the mass is cooked until curds separate from clear whey, then stirred with egg, butter, salt and caraway into a firm ball. The temperature and size figures come from Wikipedia, not from the TSG regulation.

steps.note: The mass is cooked until the curds separate from the clear whey, which is drawn off.
The curd is stirred into a firm ball.
steps.what: egg, butter or cream, salt and caraway seeds

steps.name: rest
steps.note: The cheese is left to rest in cheesecloth, often pressed, for a few days.
